summary.text: Alexis Simmons is a Democratic state representative from Kansas House District 58 who has represented the district since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Simmons is a consultant who succeeded Vic Miller in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Alexis Simmons earned a bachelor's degree from Washburn University and a graduate degree from American University, and her career experience includes working as a consultant.

She has been affiliated with the League of Women Voters-Shawnee County, the Capital Area Democratic Women's Club, the Kansas Chamber of Commerce, the City of Topeka's Human Relations Commission and the International Public Policy Institute.
Simmons succeeded Vic Miller in the District 58 seat and took office on January 13, 2025.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Elections, Legislative Modernization, Water, and Welfare Reform committees, and she is the ranking minority member of the Legislative Modernization Committee.
She faces Republican Michael Mathewson in the general election.
